svg.aria-label: Left: total variation distance to the uniform distribution on a log scale against the number of steps, for two random walks on a cycle of 20 states. The plain walk stays at 0.5 because it is periodic; the lazy walk falls in a straight line on the log scale, parallel to the dashed line lambda-two to the n. Right: the first 3,000 iterations of two Metropolis-Hastings chains targeting modes at minus 3 and plus 3; with step 0.1 the chain stays near one mode, with step 4 it jumps between both
svg.text: a walk on a cycle of 20 states
